insights.one_liner: Deloitte is one of the Big Four audit, tax and consulting firms, an IND recognised sponsor, though its Dutch workforce shrank in 2026.

culture.text: One of the four big accounting and advisory firms, doing audit, tax, consulting and deal advice.
A huge global network of about 345,374 people in 2021.
Current entry-level roles here are in risk/compliance and finance, in Amsterdam and Rotterdam.

open.text: Recognised by the IND as a visa sponsor through several entities, including Deloitte Accountancy & Advies B.V.
Both current entry-level jobs here don't require Dutch.

growth.text: Grew worldwide revenue to $74.5 billion, though growth in technology advice slowed.
Deloitte's Dutch workforce is shrinking, with mainly fewer young people.
Grew from 334,800 staff in 2020 to 345,374 in 2021, with revenue of $50.2 billion in 2021.

worth_knowing.text: The Dutch cooperative got leaner while profit for partners rose.
Deloitte is considering a complaint about an investigation by the Dutch Whistleblowers Authority (Huis voor Klokkenluiders).
A new group of trainees started at Deloitte.
